name: Argythamnia

project_scope.selection_mode: three already-installed canonical species; genus lesson builder
project_scope.source_pool: Master Plant Pool; Genus Study Index

shared_genus_recognition.look_here_first: On a flowering shoot, find the axillary raceme and identify separate small staminate and pistillate flowers (typically pistillate nearer its base). Examine a capsule or seed if available. Check whether leaves have petioles and measure the raceme from its base to tip before attempting species identification.
shared_traits: Euphorbiaceae herbs or low subshrubs, generally with simple alternate leaves
Small unisexual flowers in axillary inflorescences; reproductive structures carry more weight than habit or color
Typically three-carpellate capsules and seeds that can provide useful confirmation
shared_genus_recognition.caution: General silvery or hairy appearance and low limestone-site habit do not establish genus or species; check flowers and fruits.

species_comparison_matrix.Argythamnia aphoroides: Not established as a safe binary separator in current canonical note; photograph node and petiole
species_comparison_matrix.Argythamnia humilis: Small alternate blades; leaf attachment varies and requires matched material
species_comparison_matrix.Argythamnia simulans: Sessile blades (leaf base directly attached to stem)

species_comparison_matrix.Argythamnia aphoroides: Axillary raceme with basal pistillate and distal staminate flowers; exact length threshold not yet validated
species_comparison_matrix.Argythamnia simulans: Conspicuously long axillary racemes, roughly 3.5–12 cm in existing reviewed species treatment

species_comparison_matrix.Argythamnia aphoroides: Macro needed for species-level separation; current record does not supply verified count
species_comparison_matrix.Argythamnia humilis: Petals free from androphore; usually 10 stamens
species_comparison_matrix.Argythamnia simulans: Detailed stamen/androphore thresholds need targeted review

species_comparison_matrix.Argythamnia aphoroides: Pistillate flowers proximal on raceme; species-level style details not established
species_comparison_matrix.Argythamnia humilis: Very small pistillate petals and flattened stigmas
species_comparison_matrix.Argythamnia simulans: Inspect proximal pistillate flowers; species-level stigma characters require review

species_comparison_matrix.Argythamnia aphoroides: Non-muricate three-carpellate capsule; seeds lacking caruncle
species_comparison_matrix.Argythamnia humilis: Three-part capsule; seed surface smooth to rugose or papillate
species_comparison_matrix.Argythamnia simulans: Fruit and seed measurements/surface needed for safe comparison

species_comparison_matrix.Argythamnia aphoroides: Low perennial on limestone sites; weak separator
species_comparison_matrix.Argythamnia humilis: Low erect-to-prostrate perennial, variable hairiness; weak separator
species_comparison_matrix.Argythamnia simulans: Perennial or subshrub; gray-green appearance not diagnostic

field_key_training.look: leaf node and full axillary raceme photographed beside a millimeter ruler
field_key_training.if: Leaves clearly sessile AND racemes consistently conspicuously long (~3.5–12 cm)
field_key_training.then: A. simulans is a strong candidate; confirm floral/fruit details. Keep its unresolved native-range metadata unchanged.

field_key_training.look: raceme length, male flowers, and androphore under hand lens or macro
field_key_training.if: Short axillary racemes AND staminate petals free from androphore, typically ten stamens
field_key_training.then: A. humilis is supported; check pistillate stigmas and seed surface.

field_key_training.look: raceme sex distribution, mature capsule and seeds
field_key_training.if: Proximal pistillate + distal staminate flowers, non-muricate three-part capsule and seeds without a caruncle
field_key_training.then: A. aphoroides is possible; current evidence does not establish an exclusive species key, so compare against A. humilis and A. simulans.

field_key_training.if: Only habit/leaf color is visible, or characters overlap
field_key_training.then: Record Argythamnia sp.; request flowers, mature fruit and seed macros rather than forcing an ID.

overlap_and_cautions: All three can be low perennials or subshrubs; growth form is not a dependable separator.
Hairiness varies within A. humilis and can be distorted by lighting; do not use grayness as a diagnostic shortcut.
A. simulans is retained in the learner with its existing RANGE_UNRESOLVED status; genus inclusion is not native-range certification.
The reported A. simulans raceme length is sourced from its existing species record, not independently remeasured here.
A. aphoroides and A. humilis are not safely distinguished by habit or limestone habitat alone; verify reproductive characters before presenting a hard dichotomous key.
Synonyms in Ditaxis should route to accepted Argythamnia species concepts, not duplicate cards.

local_lookalike_routing.separate: Check for conspicuous stinging hairs and different raceme/pedicel organization; do not handle without protection.
Examine enlarged pistillate bracts, often toothed/lobed, and inflorescence structure; compare flower morphology rather than leaf hairiness.
Check for stellate or scaly indumentum, gland and inflorescence details; do not assume silvery foliage is Argythamnia.
Find cyathia (cup-like pseudoflowers) instead of the separate conventional staminate/pistillate flowers of Argythamnia.

diagnostic_photo_checklist.show: stem node, petiole presence/absence, leaf base, ruler
diagnostic_photo_checklist.separates: sessile A. simulans candidate from other records

diagnostic_photo_checklist.show: base-to-tip measurement; proximal female and distal male flower positions
diagnostic_photo_checklist.separates: short A. humilis versus long A. simulans; tests A. aphoroides architecture

diagnostic_photo_checklist.show: petal insertion, androphore, individual stamens, count
diagnostic_photo_checklist.separates: A. humilis free petals and usually ten stamens; test other taxa

diagnostic_photo_checklist.show: petals, stigmas and style branches, reproductive bracts
diagnostic_photo_checklist.separates: flattened stigmas in A. humilis versus comparison taxa
non-muricate A. aphoroides fruit versus unresolved comparisons

diagnostic_photo_checklist.show: seed apex, caruncle presence/absence, papillate/rugose texture, scale
diagnostic_photo_checklist.separates: A. aphoroides no caruncle; A. humilis surface variability; check A. simulans

existing_media_reuse.note: A. humilis currently has one provisional whole-voucher learner image with reuse rights unverified. It is NOT evidence for floral thresholds and must not be reused outside existing context without licensing review.

handoffs.question: Verify a defensible published species-level separator: petiole and raceme measurements, male petal/androphore relation, style/stigma form, seed caruncle and sculpture. Do not invent thresholds.
Check overlap of sessile leaf attachment and 3.5–12 cm raceme range; verify published fruit/seed and flower diagnostics; preserve existing RANGE_UNRESOLVED metadata.
Acquire matched, licensed reproductive macros keyed to the checklist; provisional A. humilis whole-voucher photo has unverified reuse rights.
